items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: he had a lot of connections with good arrangers like John Bantee

ctx.x: So that became this new trend because he had a lot of connections with good arrangers like John Bantee and the other guy from Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey, everyone because he was the one to give the okay in Chick Webb's band for those arrangements. So he was doing a favor to a lot of guys in that particular, that particular way, so we had a lot of favors from those people. We are very grateful because we don't have no money to pay all those top-flight arrangers.
Okay. At The Great White Way, you and your orchestra was there without Mario. How many men did you have in that orchestra?
